name: Schonstedt Maggie Magnetic Locator with Soft Case
description: The Maggie combines the best features of two flagship Schonstedt products, the sensitivity and precision of the GA-52Cx, and the single-handed operation of the GA-92XT. Land Surveyors sometimes call magnetic locators pin finders, or survey pin finder, or even a metal detector. Soft Carrying case is included along with a 7 year warranty.

name: Seco Double Right Angle Prism
description: This compact and precise right angle prism allows for easy determination of right angle points or perpendicular points between two targets. Permits stepping off angles of 90 and 180 degrees. Center lens allows foresight viewing. The protective metal cover rotates to expose the pentagonal prisms. Slot in handle accommodates plumb bob cord.

name: Sokkia Large Stake Flags 30" 4" x 5" 100 per Bundle Yellow Glo
description: The Sokkia Large Stake Flags 30in 4in x 5in 1 000pcs Flags is a vinyl flags securely attached to stiff steel wire stakes. Packed 100 to a bundle with 10 bundles per box.

name: Seco Column Clamp for Instruments
description: The Seco Column Clamp for Instruments 4852-15 means you don't need a tripod to mount your laser or theodolite. The 4852-15 gives rotational and height adjustments.
